Red and Blue trainer sprite artwork: Pokémon / Game Freak / Nintendo, as distributed by Pokémon Showdown.

Trainer sprites are game artwork, not original open-source artwork.

Regional trainer portraits: Pokémon Showdown trainer sprite collection. Official game art and credited community anime sprites; not all artwork is open-source. See individual source URLs in assets/sources.json and https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/trainers/ for sprite artist credits.
